summary: Fixed gridcalc to follow the docs: column indexing, number tokens with exponents, operator precedence (prefix minus looser than right-grouped ^), %.10g number text, reversed range corners, empty undefined cells, text skipped in SUM/AVERAGE/MIN/MAX ranges, lazy IF, bool type naming, cell-order sorting, refs de-duplication, ROUND precision and whitespace handling in sheet lines. All unit tests pass and the documents match the expected ones.
